summary: Avidia Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its board authorized a stock buyback plan effective August 4, 2026, permitting repurchase of up to $30 million in common stock. Repurchases may occur on the open market or in private transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 trading plans. Timing and size depend on pricing, market conditions, and capital position. The plan expires July 31, 2027 and may be modified, suspended, or discontinued without notice. No price per share, premium, advisor, or other deal terms were specified. This is a discretionary capital return program rather than a fixed tender offer. Monitoring factors include buyback pacing and impact on share count and capital ratios.
